 Crm (A) 1824 of 2024
 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code
 Criminal Procedure in connection with Kaliganj Police Station Case No. 955
 2023 dated 29.12.2023 under Sections 498A/328/307/34 of

And
 In Re: Jhilik Bibi Sekh @ Jhilik Khatun & Anr.
 Petitioners
 Mr. Sumanta Das
 Ms. Atreyee Halder
 For the Petitioners
 Mr. Sudip Kumar
 Mr. Debanshu Ghorai

For the State  Mr. Manas Kumar Das  For the defcto complainant  1.
The learned Counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the matrimonial disputes between the parties have been resolved.
2. The learned Counsel for the de-facto complainant, on instruction, has submitted that she is presently residing happily with her husband.
3. In view of the aforesaid, we are inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.
Code vs In Re: Jhilik Bibi Sekh @ Jhilik Khatun & ... on 10 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136016508/

1 4. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioners, namely, Jhilik Bibi Sekh @ Jhilik Khatun and Jamena Bibi Sekh @ Jamena Sekh, shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.2500/- each, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure to the satisfaction of arresting officer.
The petitioners shall meet the I.O. as and when required.
The petitioners shall appear before the learned Trial Court within a fortnight from today.
5. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is allowed.

6. CRM (A) 1824 of 2024 is, thus, disposed of.
7.
All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Uday Kumar, J.)
